style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, crisp shadows, high exposure
motion_rule: in every window he struts or fans his tail, or the goose or the tray crosses the whole frame; he never holds a pose; new shot size and camera move every window, never on a schedule; his wattle swings in speech too
character: a huge bronze turkey, red wobbling wattle, a vast fanning tail, puffed up and pompous
second_characters: ONE skinny goose in a white apron, dragging the steel tray past the lens all clip, never still
props: ONE long garden table; ONE huge steel roasting tray; ONE sprig of rosemary; his fanned tail; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the tray is in frame all clip, creeping closer to him every window; the rosemary is in the goose's beak until 6.1
environment: a sunlit farmyard: long table on gravel, whitewashed wall

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: plummy pompous male voice, unhurried and certain, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: E-tat, da-ZHIT stress last, SLE-du-yu-shche-va stress first, ta-ra-PEES, dru-ZHOK, PRAZD-nik, SKO-ra, na-STU-pit stress middle
audio.pacing: 0.9-3.75 one breath; one pause only, 3.75-4.3; 4.3-7.2 one breath; after 7.2 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his beak opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a gobble, tail feathers snapping open, steel scraping gravel

timeline.a: the steel tray slides across the lens and clears it
he steps onto the table, gravel flying off his feet
he puffs to twice his size, the goose ducking under him
he swings his wattle at the lens and stamps the table
he wheels a half turn, the goose hauling the tray behind him
his tail snaps full open across the frame, he struts the whole table
timeline.c: wide, track him all the way

timeline.a: no words. The goose drops the tray, it clangs and skids past the lens
he walks at the camera till he fills the frame
he taps one claw on the lens, feathers on the glass
he throws both wings wide, the tail flaring behind him
he rocks the table, the rosemary flips at the lens
he leans in till one eye and the wattle fill the frame
no words. He struts on and the goose slides the tray in under him
the goose vaults the tray and drags it across the frame
he fans the tail shut and open again, gravel flying
he winks and a glowing white knot emblem of six looped petals blooms across his open eye, the tray behind him
timeline.c: macro on the eye, slide out

must_appear: the goose dragging the tray past the lens all clip, his tail snapping full open at 2.65, he struts the whole table, the tray sliding in under him at 7.2, a wink at 9.3 with the knot emblem in his eye
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, low key, floating props, a still camera, a human hand with a microphone, an interview stand, him standing still at the table while speaking, a second turkey, more geese, people, slow motion, speed ramp, any word after 7.2, silence in the tail, accented Russian, he holds a pose, letters, numbers, cyrillic, pseudo-cyrillic scribble, subtitles, watermark, English speech, black bands
